Question B-004-006-007.

Why the correct answer is right: Lowest precision means the largest tolerance percentage, so 20% is the least precise listed value.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "0.1%": This is the smallest listed percentage and therefore highest precision. Numeric check: 0.1% is much smaller than 5%, 10%, or 20%.
- sourceIndex 2: "5%": This is not the lowest precision because 10% and 20% allow wider variation. Numeric check: 5% < 10% < 20%.
- sourceIndex 3: "10%": This is less precise than 5% but still more precise than 20%. Numeric check: 10% is half of 20%.
